separate_algebra_result.claim: For every even N>=2 the certified target orbit embeds with N-2 unstable, one neutral and 2N stable Floquet directions, conditional on the inherited target certificate and the explicit direct-sum argument
separate_algebra_result.general_replication: For N=m*k balanced clusters, the quotient is the exact k-row model; chi_N=chi_k*product(chi_a^(m-1)). A cyclic spatiotemporal permutation of all k clusters makes chi_N=chi_k*chi_perp^(N-k). This is an algebraic conditional statement, not a new existence computation.
separate_algebra_result.unequal_partition: For group sizes m_a summing to N, the quotient uses weights m_a/N and weighted displacement constraint. chi_N=chi_weighted*product(chi_a^(m_a-1)). No equality between cluster spectra is assumed.
